author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
Jira has a limit of 500 child tickets under an Epic.   I will never hit this limit if I use Jira manually, only an AI agent would hit this limit.

Is Jira robust enough for the AI-era?   

There are rumors that Anthropic is going to acquire Atlassian.
Anthropic please acquire Atlassian rewrite it in Rust.
